finding.title: Medium package vulnerability on development container image
finding.description: A medium severity package vulnerability affects a development image. The package is not directly internet exposed.

llm_analysis.summary: A medium severity package vulnerability (CVE-2026-54321) was detected in a development container image that is not directly exposed to the internet.
llm_analysis.rationale: The vulnerability is medium severity and affects a development environment container image. The image is not directly internet exposed, which reduces the immediate risk of exploitation. However, development environments can be a source of vulnerabilities if images are later promoted to production or if the environment is accessed by unauthorized users. Therefore, the risk is not low and warrants attention.
llm_analysis.recommended_action: Review the vulnerability details and apply available patches or updates to the affected package in the development container image. Ensure that the development environment is properly isolated and access-controlled. Monitor for any promotion of this image to production and reassess risk accordingly.

policy_decision.recommended_action: Document the finding and require analyst validation.
